scope_prohibited: Live trading, order routing, or any connection to a brokerage
Use of real (non-synthetic) market or portfolio data
Any claim of regulatory, model-risk, or security certification

failure_modes: Not evaluated out-of-distribution: different volatility regime, jump risk, or real market microstructure.
Trained and evaluated with a single random seed per call; objective_history shows convergence on that one training seed, not across seeds.
No formal verification that the tanh action bound [-1, 1] is appropriate outside a single-share-per-option vanilla setting.
Synthetic one-firm economy and single-asset GBM; no empirical calibration/identification.
Inflation is an annualized log change of traded model-good prices, not CPI.
Potential output is a configured physical reference, not an estimated GDP/output gap.
The payroll rate channel is a demand rule; it does not post loan/interest transactions.
Economic cash/equity and floating-point hedge accounts remain separate balance sheets.
The bounded feedback rule has no optimizing policy or central-bank balance sheet.
Conditional CVaR freezes holdings and rates; future macro/policy updates are omitted.
Black-Scholes marks freeze the closing rate to expiry; no stochastic-rate Q model is solved.
MLP training uses constant-initial-rate GBM; feedback rates can shift outside that setting.
One realized trajectory is not evidence of policy superiority or statistical significance.
Failed steps halt without rollback; atomicity covers individual economic market batches.
Latest published macro observations can remain stale when no new goods trades occur.
model_cards.input_schema_summary: Per path per step: (log(S_t / strike), fraction of time-to-maturity remaining in [0, 1], previous holding in [-1, 1]), each a float32 scalar. Output: a tanh-bounded target holding in [-1, 1].
model_cards.intended_use: Research demonstration of CVaR-based deep hedging (Buehler et al. 2019) on synthetic single-asset European-option GBM paths. Not calibrated to, or validated against, real market data.
model_cards.metric_uncertainty_note: One realized coupled macro-financial path. This is not a sample CVaR estimate or policy superiority. Conditional CVaR freezes current holdings/rates.
model_cards.model_type: Feedforward MLP hedging policy (3 inputs, 2 hidden layers of 32 units, tanh-bounded scalar output)
model_cards.prohibited_use: Any live trading, order routing, or real-money hedging decision. Any use outside the single-asset European vanilla call/put GBM setting it was trained on (not evaluated under Heston, jumps, multiple assets, or real market microstructure).
model_cards.training_data_summary: 1500 synthetic GBM paths (prometheus.stochastica.gbm), physical-measure, seed=4219450349; no empirical/historical data. Policy seed=1239125993.
